name: QtSpim
tagline: A self-contained simulator that runs MIPS32 programs
blurb: QtSpim is a self-contained simulator that runs MIPS32 programs.
description:
QtSpim is a self-contained simulator that runs MIPS32 programs. It reads and executes assembly language programs written for this processor.
QtSpim also provides a simple debugger and minimal set of operating system services.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
